set.body:
Scheduling lane: research. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Research comparison retained; frozen exposure/eligibility rules apply. Not an engineering prerequisite or proof of behavioral recovery.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 1b Tasks and Tracks.

The library mapper and decoders need per-corpus settings as data. The existing descriptor is storymodel4s.corpus.descriptor/v1 (ADR 0018; corpus-intake Descriptor.scala; tools/recall-study/corpus_descriptor.py). This ticket extends it without reading the Phase 1a results, so engineering does not wait on the readout.

Scope:
A versioned descriptor extension and its readers on both sides; no leaderboards.

Acceptance criteria:
1. A new descriptor version adds, per corpus: task definitions (unit, gold, eligibility, primary estimand = participant average, secondary series), track inputs T1-T4 with input hashes, and decoder settings as data.
2. The Scala emitter (corpusIntake) and the Python reader (corpus_descriptor.py) both handle it; a round-trip test and a refusal test for unknown versions exist on each side.
3. Descriptors exist for Sherlock, FilmFestival (film identity), Friends (WhichEvent, veridical only) and Memento (from its task descriptor).
4. Fields for split sizes and minimum detectable effects exist and are filled from the sealed-split records.

Gate (AGENTS.md SD2/SD6): `sbt -batch clean compileAll testAll` on the merge result, then
`sbt -batch scalafmtCheckAll scalafmtSbtCheck` as a separate run; every test task in build.sbt's
testAll alias reports bound totals (56 at 0e36a7fa, after the corpus modules were added; recount if
modules change); a named mutation witness per new guard, and each compile-time-probe mutation proved
after its own clean recompile; `cd docs-site && npm run verify:examples` when public API or examples
change; fresh-context cold review in a separate pass; the commit body states the evidence and what
it does not establish.

Size: M.
set.title: [research] Phase 1b: task, track and estimand fields in the corpus descriptor (schema only)
